description: Sécurité routière - Accidentologie 2013 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direction Départementale des Territoires de Saône-et-Loire. Assessment of accidentology in Saône-et-Loire in 2013 giving the main figures of accidentality (avoid confounding accidentology and accidentality and accidentology. The first is a method of study, the second a value[accident rate]), Road accident leaflet in Saône-et-Loire. Coverage: Direction Départementale des Territoires de Saône-et-Loire. The portal shows the English title as "Road safety — Accidentology 2013" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direction Départementale des Territoires de Saône-et-Loire. Its keywords include accident, securite-routiere, territoires-et-transports. The listing shows 2 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2015-09-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
